text:
mai: quick q on breadcrumb behaviour in compact nav. proposal: breadcrumbs remain canonical (workspace > group > item). clicking a crumb should expand the relevant group in the rail and focus the item, but avoid page jump. figma: https://figma.com/proto/crumb-compact (frames).
jon: agree. expand+focus is expected. prefer focus then smooth scrollIntoView({block:'center'}) so the target isn't lost.
rita: routing thought: keep canonical deep links as path segments (/w/x/nav/projects/alpha). UI state (open groups, pins) should not pollute the canonical URL by default. use history.state for ephemeral state.
a11y-bot: accessibility checklist: 1) group headers role=button, tabindex=0; 2) aria-expanded, aria-controls; 3) pin uses aria-pressed; 4) announce "Navigation restored" when loading a shared view; 5) test keyboard flows.
mai: also propose a small "Copy view (open groups)" action that encodes UI state in fragment when user explicitly asks. default "Copy link" stays clean.
jon: engineering note: fragment serializer should strip long lists and PII; base64 compress for shorter fragments. also use history.replaceState on normal nav to preserve back/forward toggles.
rita: copy nits: button label = "Copy view (includes open sections)", toast = "Exact view copied". banner when loading fragment: "This link opens extra sections" with dismiss.
deploy-bot: preview deployed: compact-crumb-ux -> staging at 2026-04-01T12:00Z :white_check_mark:
mai: thanks all 4aa i'll update figma and add PR checklist. jon will prototype expand+focus.
